en.title: Buying a Winspace bike: direct shop, local dealer or complete build?
en.description: How to compare Winspace buying routes, warehouse fulfillment, fit, support and owner experiences before ordering a frameset or complete bike.
en.intro: Winspace gives you more than one way to buy. That is useful only if you compare the same thing: a frame in a box, a dealer’s assembled bike and a regionally fulfilled complete bike are three different offers.

sections.heading: Get two quotes for the same bike
paragraphs: Start at the [official dealer directory](https://www.winspace.cc/pages/authorized-dealers) and the [brand shop](https://www.winspace.cc/). Ask a nearby listed dealer for the exact model and generation you want, then compare it with the direct offer. The T1550 name alone is not a complete specification: generation, finish and package contents need to match.

A dealer quote can include work that a frame price omits. Ask whether assembly, fitting changes and the first adjustment are included, and who submits a warranty claim. Give direct ordering credit for any configuration advantage, but charge your build for the work it still needs.

sections.heading: A warehouse is a fact about your order
paragraphs: Winspace’s [shipping page](https://www.winspace.cc/pages/shipping) describes fulfillment from multiple regions. Ask which warehouse will dispatch your exact size and color. Also distinguish parcel dispatch from the final assembly and last-mile process used for some complete-bike orders.

The [complete-bike page](https://www.winspace.cc/pages/completebikes) promotes regional fulfillment in Europe and the US. Confirm whether the quoted delivered price covers your address and what happens if the carrier requests money. Do not carry a US or EU offer over to Canada without a Canadian quote.

If you have a ride or event booked, work backward from a ready-to-ride date: receipt, inspection, assembly and adjustment all belong after shipping. A tracking label is a progress update, not a bicycle.

sections.heading: Owners help expose the gaps in the quote
paragraphs: In a [November 2024 discussion](https://chinertown.com/index.php?topic=5449.0), a T1550 owner described being happy with a previous Black Friday purchase. That is a positive ownership report about that generation and transaction; it does not establish current stock or predict every support experience.

Another buyer’s [April 2025 account](https://chinertown.com/index.php/topic,5878.0.html) described a disputed damaged-frame return and delays. It is a single, unverified customer account, not an adjudicated finding. The practical lesson is to agree the arrival-damage process, preserve packaging and record the condition before assembly.
Those stories belong beside each other. Looking only for praise removes useful preparation; looking only for complaints hides the many transactions that never become a forum thread.

sections.heading: Confirm fit before custom options
paragraphs: Use the [size guidance](https://www.winspace.cc/pages/size-chart) as a starting point and compare the frame geometry with a bike that fits you. Confirm the cockpit dimensions and remaining adjustment range before ordering. A discounted frame is not a bargain if the chosen front end cannot reach your position.

Read the current [warranty](https://www.winspace.cc/pages/warranty) and [return policy](https://www.winspace.cc/pages/return-policy) for the item. Ask specifically about original-owner eligibility, unused returns, custom options, return shipping and workshop labor; those are separate issues.

Before paying, save a single order summary with the exact frame, cockpit, included small parts, seller, warehouse and delivered total. If the dealer’s additional cost buys fit certainty and nearby help that you value, include that in the decision rather than treating it as wasted money.

zh-Hans.title: Winspace 购车指南：官网直购、当地经销还是整车？
zh-Hans.description: 下单 Winspace 车架或整车前，比较官网、经销、发货仓、合身与售后，并了解有日期的车主经历。
zh-Hans.intro: Winspace 有不止一种购买方式。比较时必须先对齐商品：一箱车架、经销商装好的车、区域交付的整车，是三种不同报价。

sections.heading: 先为同一辆车拿到两份报价
paragraphs: 从[官方经销商名单](https://www.winspace.cc/pages/authorized-dealers)和[品牌商城](https://www.winspace.cc/)开始。请附近名单内经销商报价你想要的具体车型与代际，再与直购比较。仅有 T1550 名称还不够；代际、颜色和套餐内容都应一致。
经销商报价可能包含裸车架价格没有的工作。确认装配、合身调整和初次调试是否包含，以及保修由谁提交。直购能提供特殊配置是优势，但剩余工作仍要计入预算。

sections.heading: 发货仓是具体订单的信息
paragraphs: [运输说明](https://www.winspace.cc/pages/shipping)介绍了多个区域的履约安排。要问你的尺码和颜色究竟由哪个仓发出。部分整车还涉及末端装配与配送，不能把包裹发出等同于全部流程完成。
[整车页面](https://www.winspace.cc/pages/completebikes)宣传欧洲和美国区域交付。确认到手价是否覆盖你的地址，以及承运商再收钱时怎么办。没有加拿大具体报价，就不能照搬美国或欧盟方案。
若已有活动日期，要从真正能骑的日子倒推：签收、检查、装配、调整都在运输之后。单号是进度，不是一辆车。

sections.heading: 车主经历能找出报价中的空白
paragraphs: 在 [2024 年 11 月讨论](https://chinertown.com/index.php?topic=5449.0)中，一位 T1550 车主对之前黑五购买的车表示满意。这是针对该代际和交易的积极报告，不能证明当前库存或预测每次售后。
另一位买家在 [2025 年 4 月帖子](https://chinertown.com/index.php/topic,5878.0.html)中描述了损坏车架退货争议及延误。这是未经独立核实的单一客户叙述，不是裁决结果。实用启示是先确认到货损坏流程、保留包装，并在装配前记录状态。
两类故事应一起读。只找好评会错过准备事项；只找投诉，又会忽略那些从未变成论坛帖的普通交易。

sections.heading: 先确定合身，再选个性化选项
paragraphs: 把[尺码建议](https://www.winspace.cc/pages/size-chart)当作起点，再与已合身的车比较几何。下单前确认把组尺寸和剩余调整空间。若前端无法达到你的姿势，打折车架也未必划算。
阅读当前[保修](https://www.winspace.cc/pages/warranty)及[退货政策](https://www.winspace.cc/pages/return-policy)，分别问原始买家资格、未使用退货、定制选项、退运费与车店工时。
付款前保存一份完整订单摘要：车架、把组、内含小配件、卖家、仓库及到手总额。经销商差价若换来你重视的合身把握和附近支持，应把这些价值算进去。
